thread:
yang: Heads up — nightly eval (2026-03-19) for the new PTQ variant (model v2.3-ptq-lite) shows a coherence drop on the finance promptset. Reproducible on canary.

ajay: how big is the drop? numbers?

yang: quick summary: KL(float32 || ptq) jumped from ~0.018 to 0.17 on the finance set. Factual precision metric fell 4.1 points. Examples look like premature topic switches and truncated numbers. reproducer attached.

maria: model artifact id + quant config?

yang: artifact: rwd-models/fin-v2.3-ptq-lite:20260318-01
quant config: int8 asymmetric per-channel, packedkv enabled, kv_stride=2, per-layer outlier clamp=0.02

elena: did the nightly just flip to this quant build? or config drift?

yang: nightly brought up PTQ pipeline change at 03:10am — new packedkv kernel landed in runtime. CI passed unit tests but eval regressed.

deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd-models/fin-v2.3-ptq-lite:20260318-01 -> node-group canary-ptq-01 (started 03:12am)

ci-bot: nightlies: eval-run #20260319-84 finished. overall: FAIL (regression threshold exceeded for finance_coherence).

ajay: can you paste a minimal failing example? helps narrow whether truncation vs hallucination.

yang: sure — one sample:
```
Q: "What was ACME's revenue in Q4 2024?"
Float32: "ACME reported $3.2B in revenue for Q4 2024, up 6% yoy."
PTQ-lite: "They reported several billion in revenue. In other news, the board is exploring new options."
```

maria: looks like early termination / context window loss. Could be KV cache stride or packedkv write ordering.

ops_sam: checked logs on canary nodes — we see occasional OOM-ish GC spikes at the same time as long requests, followed by truncated stream closes. Not full OOM, but device-side kernel timeouts recorded.

yang: interesting — latency tail increased ~40ms p95 for generate calls on canary during the run. That aligns with kernel retries causing early stopseq.

elena: immediate mitigation: gate the PTQ build from full rollout and rollback canary to previous quant config. Also tighten our canary SLOs to failfast on coherence KL jumps >0.05.

ajay: agree. action: rollback canary to rwd-models/fin-v2.3-ptq-baseline:20260301-02. Who will run?

maria: I can trigger rollback and pin model config. Doing a dry run now.

maria: rollback started -> deploy-bot: rolling update to baseline on canary-ptq-01 (03:44am)

ci-bot: post-rollback nightly subrun: finance_coherence restored to within 0.01 of float baseline. PASS.

yang: follow-ups for root cause investigation:
- reproduce locally with packedkv toggles (packedkv on/off, kv_stride 1 vs 2)
- run perf traces to capture device kernel timeouts and retries
- re-run PTQ calibration with tighter outlier clamp and verify distribution shifts

ajay: assign owners: reproduction + perf trace -> ajay + ops_sam. PTQ recalibration -> maria. Gating rule + rollout change -> elena.

elena: I'll also add a canary rule: if KL(finance) delta > 0.03 OR p95 latency increase > 25ms, abort rollout and auto-rollback. Add to rollout config and canary dashboard.

ops_sam: starting perf trace capture on canary nodes (03:58am). I'll share kernel logs + nvprof snippets.

maria: starting PTQ recalibration sweep (tighten outlier clamp to 0.01, try symmetric quant for select layers). Will post eval matrix.

ajay: reproduction note — locally saw the same truncation when packedkv + kv_stride=2 + packed-kernel-version=3. When switching kv_stride=1 or using non-packed KV kernel, truncation disappears. Suspect packed kernel has subtle race when stride>1 under tail latency.

yang: good lead. if packed kernel is the trigger, we should disable packedkv by default for new PTQ builds until kernel fixes.

elena: interim policy: block packedkv=true in quant pipeline for finance-sensitive models + add canary test that runs full finance promptset with diversity seeds.

maria: updating quant pipeline to force packedkv=false for fin-* models. Patch landed 04:28am.

ci-bot: patch CI: quant-pipeline unit tests + full finance-nightly smoke passed.

yang: next steps / backlog items:
- root cause PR for packed kernel race (eng-runtime) -> owner: ajay
- runtime kernel telemetry to emit kernel version + stride metadata in traces -> owner: ops_sam
- extend nightly eval to include random-seed diversity for finance set -> owner: elena
- update canary gating thresholds and document rollback playbook -> owner: elena + oncall

elena: timeline: rollback done, gate in place, quant pipeline change deployed. we'll keep canary offline for 24h while kernel root cause is triaged.

yang: thanks all. will keep thread updated with repro logs and PR refs. closing loop once kernel fix + PTQ recalibration verified. :thumbsup:
